notes: Inbound SMB lead from Product Hunt listing. Short company background: small remote team (14 engs), building a VS Code + web-based code assistant that ingests entire repo + docs (long context). Primary asks: 1) long-context model support (they want to feed up to ~200k tokens via chunking/prefix cache), 2) clear rate limiting/burst policy (developer beta with ~30-50 concurrent users doing streaming completions), 3) first-class SDKs (TypeScript + Go) with streaming and reconnect guidance, 4) examples for chunking / retrieval augmented generation and cost estimates. Cost sensitivity high — will start self-serve hosted but want predictable unit economics; interested in recommendations for batching + caching to control token spend. Security: require SSO (SAML) for admin console, retention controls (30/90/365 day options) and audit logs for admin actions. Legal asked for SOC2 report and data residency options (EU customers soon). CT0 asked "can we keep embedding vectors in our own namespace?" — we suggested client-side hashing + namespacing; follow-up with SE. Sales notes: warm, technical, quick decisions, founder said "we just need something reliable we can plug into in <2 weeks". Next: schedule 60m deep-dive with runtime engineer to push a sample workload and validate throughput and streaming stability. POC success criteria: stable streaming for 50 concurrent dev sessions, average p95 latency < 400ms per token for interactive completions under burst, and implementation guidance for repo-level retrieval. Quick wins: share SDK snippets, batching guidance doc, and a sample billing estimate based on their projected token volumes.
